correctness.rationale: For each positive box, the projected zonotope gives B=bc|U1|+ac|U2|+ab|U3|. Exact Dirichlet(1/2,1/2,1/2) absolute coordinate integrals, including E|U1U2U3|=1/(4pi), yield raw moment formulas. Centralization gives kappa3=3(4-pi)xyz/(8pi)-(16-5pi)(x+y+z)(xy+yz+zx)/(8pi). The exact ratio identity (s q-9xyz)/xyz=sum pairwise (x-y)^2/(xy) translates to squared side-ratio discrepancies. The strict cube maximum and negative sign follow from pi<22/7<16/5. Independent deterministic numerical diagnostics and direct convex-hull geometry passed; finite sampling does not prove the theorem.

value.rationale: The third central moment is a canonical, measurable statistic of random cuboid shadow areas. Its uniformly negative sign for all aspect ratios is not evident from the full distribution and depends on the close rational-pi inequality 7pi<22. At fixed volume the cube is the unique extremizer and the complete difference is an exact dimensionless squared-aspect-ratio energy, giving a natural quantitative shape discriminator rather than an arbitrary numerical table; no unproved downstream claims are required.
